Test Case Description: Verify successful Token creation with valid username & password
Test Steps:
1. POST https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/auth with JSON body containing username=admin and password=password123
2. Header: Content-Type: application/json
3. Fire the request and capture response
Expected Result: HTTP 200 and response body contains a token field (string). Trace: PRD Scope: Authentication; Inclusions: Auth - CreateToken

Test Case Description: Verify successful booking creation with valid payload
Test Steps:
1. POST https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/booking with Content-Type: application/json
2. Body: firstname=Jim, lastname=Brown, totalprice=111, depositpaid=true, bookingdates.checkin=2018-01-01, bookingdates.checkout=2019-01-01, additionalneeds=Breakfast
3. Header: Accept: application/json
4. Fire the request
Expected Result: HTTP 200 and response contains bookingid and booking object matching submitted data. Trace: PRD Scope: Create (POST) Operations

3. Fire the request
Expected Result: HTTP 4xx and validation message returned; booking not created. Trace: PRD Scope: Data Validation; Inclusions: Create (POST)

Test Case Description: Verify full update of booking when authorized
Test Steps:
1. Obtain token via POST /auth with valid credentials
2. PUT /booking/{id} with Content-Type: application/json and Cookie: token=<token> or Authorization header
3. Body: full booking JSON with updated fields
4. Fire the request
Expected Result: HTTP 200 and response body reflects updated booking; data persisted. Trace: PRD Scope: Update (PUT) Operations and Authentication

Test Case Description: Verify update is rejected when not authorized
Test Steps:
1. PUT /booking/{id} without Cookie or Authorization header
2. Header: Content-Type: application/json
3. Fire the request
Expected Result: HTTP 4xx (401/403) and no update occurs. Trace: PRD Scope: Authentication and Authorization

Test Case Description: Verify deletion of booking when authorized
Test Steps:
1. Obtain token via POST /auth
2. DELETE /booking/{id} with Cookie: token=<token> or Authorization header
3. Fire the request
Expected Result: HTTP 200 (OK) and subsequent GET /booking/{id} returns 404 or not found. Trace: PRD Scope: Delete (DELETE) Operations and Authentication
